gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement p4 prints Local receipts General 299,664 and Road 5,422 and, under Other Financing Sources, Sale of assets General 768 + Road 41,250 = 42,018 (Total receipts 2,286,483). The budgetary schedules count the sale of assets inside Local: General Fund p8 Local 300,432 (= 299,664 + 768), Road Fund p9 Local 46,672 (= 5,422 + 41,250). Detail revenue 2,328,501 - 42,018 = 2,286,483 = statement. The statement's 42,018 is recorded in other_financing. No fix (schedule lines as printed).

Statement p4 Transfers - in: Road 377,041 + Road Bond 12,000 + Non-Major 5,000 = 394,041; General Fund column 0. The General Fund budgetary schedule p8 (and the General Fund combining statement p5, General Fund sub-column) prints Transfers - in 40,000 and Transfers - out (45,000); the p4 General Fund column nets transfers within the combined General Fund (in 0, out (17,000) = 40,000 - 45,000 - 12,000 Inheritance Tax Fund). Detail 434,041 - 40,000 = 394,041. Gross vs net presentation of intra-General-Fund transfers; no fix.

Statement p4 Transfers - out: General (17,000) + Emergency Road (377,041) = (394,041). Detail: General Fund p8 (45,000) + Inheritance Tax Fund p5 (12,000) + Emergency Road p11 (377,041) = (434,041). The p4 General Fund column nets the 40,000 transfer between the General Fund's own sub-funds (p5: 40,000 in, 45,000 + 12,000 out, total (17,000)). 434,041 - 40,000 = 394,041. Gross vs net; no fix.
